feature: The small local model that runs background chores (product-name translation) instead of the chat model

notes.why: Translating a Thai product name into the English label an image prompt is built from is about eighty tokens of dictionary work. Routing it through a 9B chat model meant loading 5 GB next to an image model, swapping, and having the resource governor take the chat model away before the translation finished.
notes.choice: The smallest downloaded .gguf that fits maxSizeGb. An explicit preferredModel wins when that file exists. Nothing here changes which model answers a conversation.
notes.fallback: If the small model cannot be loaded, the request falls back to the chat model when it is ready, and says so once per minute in the log.
notes.memory: This model is loaded by the arena pool (its own llama-server, its own port), so it can sit next to an image model without unloading anything.
